The '''Geonosian alphabet''' was the written form of the [[Geonosian (language)/Legends|language]] used by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Insect/Legends|insects]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].

==Behind the scenes==
For [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], a highly angular written form of Geonosian was developed by [[Philip Metschan]] at the request of [[George Lucas]]. This font type was developed in conjunction with "[[Unidentified script (Star Wars '76)|Star Wars '76]]" based upon an earlier [[Joe Johnston]] typeface used in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. The "Geonosian" typeface can be seen woven into the Geonosian Death Star display screens throughout ''Episode II''.<ref name="Metschan">{{WebCite|url=http://www.metschanmedia.com/philip_metschan//portfolio.htm|text=Star Wars Typefaces|work=Philip Metschan's portfolio|nobackup=1}}</ref><ref name="HoloArt">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/feature/20020716/indexp2.html|text=''Holographic'' Artist: Philip Metschan}}</ref> In ''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]'', the logo of [[Kalibac Industries]] is made of the letters "K" and I" in Metschan's Geonosian alphabet.<ref name="NEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref><ref name="Metschan" />
